WITH perRaceStats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.name as raceName,
    AVG(cr.points) as perRaceAvg,
    COUNT(*) as resultCount
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE cr.points >= 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
raceNameAvgs AS (
  SELECT 
    raceName,
    AVG(perRaceAvg) as raceNameAvg
  FROM perRaceStats
  GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT 
  prs.raceId,
  prs.raceName,
  prs.perRaceAvg,
  prs.resultCount,
  prs.perRaceAvg / rna.raceNameAvg as ratio
FROM perRaceStats prs
INNER JOIN raceNameAvgs rna ON prs.raceName = rna.raceName
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, prs.raceId
LIMIT 10;
